Show the halo for text selection menus?

ActionHalo uses accessibility access to recognize Android text selection menus and changes to the selection. Where selection changes are exposed, the initial selection stays quiet and adjusting it opens the wheel. If only a supported Copy menu is available, the wheel appears directly and selection handles remain usable. An Open halo button appears only for apps you explicitly set to button mode. Showing either control does not copy or read text. Only after you choose an action will it press the verified Copy button, read that new text in a visible window, and perform your chosen action.\n\nIt does not scan page or chat contents, monitor the clipboard, or save selected text. Text is only passed to the app or website chosen by your action. You can turn this optional feature off at any time. Apps that do not expose their selection menu still require Share or the clipboard shortcut.
